note: Model judgments from a sampled read of each repository, not a full audit. Scores are suitability as a source for domain experts for a production AI system on AWS. Repositories are the maintainer's GitHub stars that are skills, agents or plugin collections (75 of 245 stars). Nothing here was run; no script from any repository was executed.
